the addition of small quantities of PANFs to PMMA matrix results in composite films with a homogeneous dispersion of PANFs.

the morphology of the polyaniline self assembled nanofibers can be modified by the addition of SDS and that the addition of the PANFs to the PMMA matrix resulted in a composite material with a green coloration.

the morphology of polyaniline nanofibres was not affected by the presence of SDS and by the addition to the PMMA matrix, and that the presence of the nanofibres in the PMMA matrix was verified by UV–Vis and SEM.

the synthesis of polyaniline nanofibres and its use as a reinforcing agent for PMMA matrix, in the form of composite films.
the synthesis and characterization of PMMA/PANF composite films.
the synthesis of PMMA/PANF composite films by a solution casting procedure and characterization by UV–Vis spectrophotometry and SEM.

we were able to obtain a green dispersion of polyaniline nanostructures in butanone and to incorporate them into PMMA matrix by solution cast.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphology of the composite films was affected by the addition of PANFs, but the presence of PANFs was not enough to induce significant changes in the PMMA structure.
the use of a surfactant, SDS, in the synthesis of the polyaniline nanofibres, did not result in any morphological change in the polyaniline fibres.
the ultrasonic treatment of PANFs on a green solvent (such as butanone) results in a dispersion of PANFs with a high concentration of the nanofibers.
